title: Web3 React dApp Prototype
subtitle: Decentralized Boilerplate with Wagmi, Viem & Sepolia Testnet
summary: Modern dApp starter kit built with React 19, TypeScript, and Vite. Features MetaMask wallet connection, on-chain state reading, and transactional smart contract execution on the Sepolia Ethereum testnet via Wagmi and Viem.
overview: Engineered as a clean, production-ready foundation for decentralized applications (dApps). Solves initial Web3 onboarding hurdles by demonstrating streamlined wallet integration, on-chain state queries, and transaction lifecycle monitoring on Ethereum Sepolia.
responsibilities: Built reactive React 19 + TypeScript architecture ensuring strict static typing against smart contract ABIs.
Integrated Wagmi and Viem clients for lightweight, high-performance communication with Sepolia nodes.
Engineered robust asynchronous state handlers for wallet signatures, mempool broadcasting, and block confirmation.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Handling non-instantaneous blockchain transaction confirmations without freezing client UI or leaving users in indeterminate states.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Orchestrated useContractWrite with useWaitForTransactionReceipt to monitor transaction mining status, automatically triggering useContractRead upon block confirmation.

futureEvolution: WalletConnect integration for mobile wallet support.
Multichain provider abstraction enabling one-click switching between Sepolia, Mainnet, Arbitrum, and Optimism.
